1	# Nova — Sprint 7 Benchmark: Bookings + Public Booking Engine
2	
3	**Scope:** Internal appointments (`/bookings`, `/bookings/[id]`) + public self-book (`/book/[studioSlug]`). Bar = Cal.com + Linear + Fresha (internal); Cal.com + Calendly + Stripe Checkout (public). Targets: studio owner triages 30 bookings in < 60s; mobile client self-books + pays deposit in < 90s.
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Part 1 — Internal Appointments
8	
9	### 1. Status lifecycle
10	Market range 5–8. Use **6 primary + 3 terminal**: `pending_deposit → confirmed → checked_in → in_progress → completed`; terminal: `cancelled`, `no_show`, `rescheduled`. Fresha and Vagaro use similar chains; Vagaro colors each state on the calendar.
11	
12	**Treatment:** pill (12px, uppercase 11px label) + colored left-border on list rows. Never icon-only — artists scan on phones. Reuse Sprint 3 `<StatusPill />`. Colors: `pending_deposit` amber · `confirmed` green · `checked_in`/`in_progress` electric-purple · `completed` gray-900 · `no_show` red · `cancelled` gray-400 strikethrough.
13	
14	### 2. List filters
15	Cal.com's `/bookings` uses view tabs (`Upcoming | Unconfirmed | Recurring | Past | Cancelled`) + a `Filters` button. Linear does the same: persistent tabs + chip-row secondary filters.
16	
17	**InkOS:** tabs `Today | This Week | Upcoming | Past | Cancelled` (URL-backed state). Chip row below: `All artists ▾` · `All services ▾` · `All statuses ▾` · `Has deposit ▾`, multi-select with checkbox dropdowns (Attio pattern from Sprint 6). `Cmd+K` global search. Inline input above table searches client name + booking ID only. Saved views: "My day", "Needs confirmation", "No-show risk".
18	
19	### 3. Bulk actions
20	Cal.com UI is one-at-a-time; Fresha allows drag-reschedule; Linear does row-select + contextual toolbar. Studio owners managing 30+/week need bulk.
21	
22	- Row checkboxes left, shift-click range select.
23	- Sticky bottom toolbar on ≥1 selection: `Reschedule · Cancel · Send reminder · Export .ics · Mark no-show`.
24	- Bulk cancel/reschedule modal shows: affected count, SMS+email preview, "Refund deposits" checkbox (default from studio policy), required `reason` field (written to `audit_log` per Sprint 1).
25	- Row skeletons during queue job; completion toast with 10s undo.
26	
27	### 4. Detail drawer
28	Linear's right slide-in (640px, full-height, `Esc` closes, `Shift+J/K` navigates) is gold standard. Full page = lose list context. Modal = no adjacent nav.
29	
30	- **Slide from right, 640px desktop / fullscreen mobile**, backdrop blur 4px.
31	- **Header:** booking ID (copyable), status pill, client avatar + name (→ `/clients/[id]`), artist avatar, overflow menu (edit · duplicate · cancel · open full page).
32	- **Collapsible sections (state remembered):**
33	  1. **At-a-glance** — start/end, duration, service, room/chair, deposit paid + balance owed.
34	  2. **Client sidebar card** — last 3 appointments with status dots, lifetime revenue, allergy/medical flags.
35	  3. **Tattoo brief** — description, placement, size, reference images grid (Sprint 3 viewer).
36	  4. **Consent & policies** — template used, signed state, deposit % applied, cancellation window.
37	  5. **Activity timeline** — every state change with actor + timestamp from `audit_log`. "Rescheduled from 04-12 14:00 by Aria — reason: client conflict."
38	  6. **Payments** — deposit charge, refunds, remainder intent, Dodo receipt link.
39	  7. **Notes** — private artist notes, not client-visible.
40	- **Sticky footer CTA** changes with status (`Confirm deposit` → `Check in` → `Mark complete` → `Collect remainder`).
41	- **Keyboard:** `J/K` prev/next, `C` confirm, `R` reschedule, `X` cancel.
42	
43	### 5. Create-appointment flow
44	Cal.com = single modal; Fresha = 3-step wizard. ~40% of creates happen mid-phone-call → speed wins → **single modal, progressive disclosure**.
45	
46	Trigger `Cmd+N` or `+ New booking`. Modal 720px, single scroll:
47	1. **Client** — typeahead against `clients` (Attio-style, 120ms debounce). `+ New client` opens nested slide-over without losing modal state.
48	2. **Service + artist** — service card grid (2-col), artist dropdown filtered by service eligibility.
49	3. **When** — mini 14-day availability calendar of selected artist's free slots; click → duration auto-fills.
50	4. **Deposit** — auto-calculated from studio policy %. Toggle `Collect now` (opens Dodo Checkout inline) vs `Send link` (email).
51	5. **Notes + references** — optional, expandable.
52	
53	Autosave draft to `localStorage` every 2s keyed by artist so a closed tab mid-call doesn't wipe state. "Resume draft?" banner on reopen. Submit disabled until client+service+artist+time set; optimistic row on submit.
54	
55	### 6. Empty + loading
56	Reuse Sprint 3 system. Empty `/bookings`: centered illustration, "No bookings yet", primary `Copy booking link`, secondary `+ New booking`. Empty filter: "No bookings match" + `Clear filters`. Loading table: 8 skeleton rows, 1.5s shimmer. Loading drawer: skeleton with 300ms min-display to avoid flash.
57	
58	---
59	
60	## Part 2 — Public Booking Engine (`/book/[studioSlug]`)
61	
62	### 1. Hero + branding
63	Cal.com offers full white-label on paid tiers; TattooPro gives artists a subdomain + logo/bio/portfolio; Fresha leans on cover photo + rating + reviews.
64	
65	- **Cover photo** 16:9 desktop / 4:3 mobile, logo overlay bottom-left, H1 studio name, tagline, `★ 4.9 (127)` → scrolls to reviews.
66	- **Trust row:** address + Maps pin, today's hours, "Est. 2019", Instagram link.
67	- **CTA:** `Book your appointment` scrolls to artist picker. Mobile: sticky bottom `Book now` bar always visible.
68	- **Brand tokens:** studio accent color overrides `--color-electric-purple` on CTAs only. Font stays InkOS default. One brand color = professional; full rebrand = chaotic.
69	
70	### 2. Artist picker
71	Fresha + TattooPro use cards with portfolio thumb + specialty chips.
72	
73	Grid 3-col desktop / 1-col mobile: portrait 1:1 200px, name + pronouns, `★ 4.9`, years-experience badge. 3 portfolio thumbs below (click → lightbox). Specialty chips: `Blackwork` `Fine line` `Japanese` (max 4, "+2" overflow). "Next available: Thu Apr 23" in muted text. "Any artist" card first for clients who don't care.
74	
75	### 3. Service selection
76	Fresha/Cal.com show price + duration + description per service.
77	
78	Card: title, 1-line description (truncate), duration `2h`, price `$250+`, deposit line `$50 to book` + ℹ tooltip explaining policy. "Consultation required" badge for large pieces. Radio-select; selected state uses Sprint 2 focus ring + electric-purple left border.
79	
80	### 4. Availability calendar
81	Cal.com supports month/week/column with configurable default; Calendly defaults to month → day. Mobile users abandon if tap targets are too small.
82	
83	- **Desktop:** month grid left + time-slot column right (Cal.com layout). Today highlighted, unavailable days grayed. Click day → right column fills with 15/30-min slot chips.
84	- **Mobile:** horizontal date strip (7-day scroll) + vertical slot list. Tap date → smooth-scroll slots. 48px min tap target. No modal layering. Inline "Times shown in PT — your time".
85	
86	### 5. Client details form
87	Stripe rule: fewer fields = higher conversion.
88	
89	- **Required:** full name, email, phone (E.164 via libphonenumber), DOB (18+ gate — legal requirement).
90	- **Tattoo brief:** placement (body-diagram picker or text), size (S/M/L chips + cm/inch), description (500 char textarea).
91	- **References:** drag-drop up to 5 images (3MB each, HEIC accepted), client-side compression before upload to Supabase Storage.
92	- **Allergies/medical:** optional textarea + "I'm pregnant" checkbox (flags for artist review).
93	- **T&Cs + age confirmation:** two unticked checkboxes.
94	
95	Autosave to `sessionStorage` so a phone call or tab close doesn't wipe progress.
96	
97	### 6. Deposit collection
98	Stack A is locked on **Dodo Payments** (MoR) — no Stripe. Match Stripe's UX shape via Dodo hosted checkout.
99	
100	Client clicks `Reserve with $50 deposit` → redirect to Dodo hosted page branded with studio logo + InkOS secondary palette. Dodo collects card/Apple Pay/Google Pay; success redirects to `/book/[studioSlug]/confirmation?booking=xyz`. Statement descriptor `STUDIO NAME — InkOS`. Webhook `/api/webhooks/dodo` moves booking `pending_deposit → confirmed` via `timingSafeEqual` HMAC (Sprint 4 pattern). Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook — idempotent retries cannot double-confirm.
101	
102	### 7. Confirmation page
103	Checkmark hero, "You're booked with Aria on Thu Apr 23 at 2:00 PM." Booking ID (copyable), add-to-calendar buttons (Google / Apple / Outlook + `.ics` download). **Policies summary card** (cancellation window, deposit refund rules, late/no-show fees — the CYA receipt). Prep checklist from studio-configurable template (hydrate, eat, no alcohol 24h). Contact line + secondary `Manage booking` magic-link (reschedule/cancel without account).
104	
105	### 8. Email + SMS templates
106	Calendly's default is plain-but-reliable; bookitlive attaches `.ics` by default; Fresha emails lead with studio cover + artist photo.
107	
108	**Email (Resend):** studio logo + 400px cover banner header; appointment details card; add-to-calendar row; collapsible policies; prep checklist; contact line; muted "Powered by InkOS" footer (removeable on Pro+). Attach `.ics`. Plain-text alt for accessibility.
109	
110	**SMS cadence:** 7d-before email, 48h SMS, 24h SMS with confirm link, 2h SMS. All per-studio configurable. SMS is plain text for deliverability.
111	
112	### 9. Mobile-first
113	70%+ of public booking traffic is mobile. Single-column throughout. Sticky bottom `Continue`/`Reserve` bar always visible. No hover-only affordances. `tel` / `email` / `cc-number` autocomplete attributes for OS fill. `<input capture="environment">` on image upload for direct camera access. LCP < 2.0s on 4G; hero `priority`, everything else lazy.
114	
115	---
116	
117	## Part 3 — Three Replica Notes for Koda
118	
119	### Replica 1 — Cal.com public booking (hero + service + availability)
120	Two-column desktop, single mobile. **Left:** studio branding stack (logo, name, rating, location), selected service card (title + duration + price + deposit), muted "Powered by InkOS" footer. **Right:** month calendar, available dates bolded, unavailable grayed; click date → calendar collapses + slot chips appear. Chips 3-col desktop / 2-col mobile, time-only (`2:00 PM`). Selected = filled electric-purple, others outline. Transitions 150ms ease-out on collapse, no layout jumps.
121	
122	### Replica 2 — Fresha appointment drawer (internal)
123	Right slide-in 640px / fullscreen mobile, backdrop blur 4px, `Esc` closes, `Shift+J/K` navigates adjacent. **Header sticky:** back chevron (mobile), booking ID + copy icon, status pill, overflow menu. **Client mini-card** top: avatar + name link, last-visit date, lifetime revenue, allergy icon if present. **Collapsible sections** in order: At-a-glance · Tattoo brief · Consent & policies · Payments · Activity timeline · Notes. **Sticky footer action bar** status-aware CTA. **Inline edit:** click any field (time, service, artist) → in-place dropdown without leaving drawer; autosave on blur with "Saved" toast.
124	
125	### Replica 3 — Stripe Checkout deposit flow (Dodo hosted equivalent)
126	Hosted page: studio logo + color on left 40% desktop / top banner mobile; payment form right 60% / below banner. Form: single-column, 56px inputs, 16px label-above spacing, one field per row except expiry/CVC (50/50). Live validation — card brand icon inline, error text below field in red. Payment methods row: Apple Pay / Google Pay prominent one-tap buttons at top, card form collapsed below `Or pay with card`. **Order summary:** collapsible top on mobile, visible sidebar desktop — service line, deposit, remainder due at appointment, policies link. Footer trust row: `🔒 Secured by Dodo`, refund policy link, support contact. **Post-success:** 1s check-scale animation → redirect to `/book/[studioSlug]/confirmation`. Never leave client on Dodo's page.
127	
128	---

12	- `AppointmentsTable.tsx` — checkbox table with search, status filter, bulk confirm/cancel, CSV export, pagination. KEEP. Sprint 7 replaces the raw `<select>` status filter with `FilterBar` chip components, adds artist multi-filter, Today/This Week shortcut chips, and deposit filter.

45	## 1. Internal Appointments — `/appointments`
46	
47	### 1.1 Page Layout
48	
49	```
50	Desktop (lg+): full-height flex column within sidebar layout
51	┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
52	│ PageHeader                                                   │
53	│ title="Appointments"  subtitle="Manage all studio bookings"  │
54	│ right={ <Button size="sm">New appointment</Button> }         │
55	├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

805	
806	-- Trigger: append to status_history on status column update

808	RETURNS TRIGGER
809	LANGUAGE plpgsql

811	AS $$
812	BEGIN
813	  IF OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
814	    NEW.status_history = COALESCE(OLD.status_history, '[]'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
815	      'from', OLD.status,
816	      'to',   NEW.status,
817	      'at',   NOW(),
818	      'by',   COALESCE(auth.uid()::text, 'system')
819	    );
820	  END IF;
821	  RETURN NEW;
822	END;
823	$$;

826	CREATE TRIGGER trg_bookings_status_history

828	  FOR EACH ROW
829	  EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_bookings_append_status_history();
